- [LCNT.5.2] **Bounded, predictable cost.** The determinism guarantee
  ([LDET.1.1]) and the `realtime` / `constspace` capabilities require
  every operation to be a total function of bounded cost — `O(1)` or
  `O(declared window)` — usually realised incrementally. Iteration
  injects unbounded, data-dependent time.
